title: Café slice A: make the part 2 runner and data file robust before the real run
item: Fix the minor problems the task 049 reviews found in .claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/examples/cafe/: the fake has only 3 hold ids and 3 confirmation ids, so a 4th hold or booking in a whole conversation raises IndexError and stops all later part 2 runs; a run that raises after API calls loses its usage from money spent; the line 3 label test accepts any non-empty ref, while several 'from the spec' entries cite no C- or R- id; data.json names tests/test_harness.py instead of tests/test_part1.py; transcripts show the confirmation id of an unanswered booking call
motivation: Reviews tasks/reviews/049-1.md and 049-2.md. The first two can waste the paid part 2 run or misreport its cost; the others weaken line 3 of task 049 or could mislead the transcript labelling.
notes: Best done before part 2 of task 049 is run. Builds on branch task/049. Dropped 2026-11-17 on the owner's instruction: folded into the retry of task 049, because the code it fixes exists only on the unmerged branch task/049.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-17 from the minor problems in the task 049 reviews. done_means and priority left for the owner.
